overreach: In a radar test workflow, Signal Generators and Signal Analyzers sit around the radar DUT as the main RF stimulus and measurement instruments.
They are used from early subsystem validation through full radar scenario simulation.
Signal Generator: provides known RF/IF test signals, LO-like stimuli, pulsed RF, chirps, or modulated waveforms
Signal Generator fit: emulates radar echoes or controlled target returns at specific frequency, power, delay, Doppler, and modulation conditions.
Signal Analyzer fit: connects to the radar transmit path through couplers/attenuators to measure transmitted waveform quality.
injects realistic target scenarios: range delay, Doppler shift, RCS amplitude variation, multi-target returns, clutter, and motion profiles
